name: Small Magellanic Cloud
tagline: The Milky Way's second satellite — a metal-poor dwarf galaxy being slowly torn apart.
history: The Small Magellanic Cloud is the Milky Way's other naked-eye satellite — a fragile irregular galaxy stretched by tides between the LMC and our own. Its metal-poor stars resemble the young universe's, making it a nearby laboratory for early cosmic chemistry. Its gas is already bleeding into the Magellanic Stream, a ribbon of material the two clouds are trailing behind them as they orbit.
